घृण् 2. घृण् (allied to rt. घृ), cl. 8. P.
A. घर्णोति, -णुते, or घृणोति, -णुते,
to shine, burn.

घृण्ण् घृण्ण्, cl. 1. A. घृण्णते, to seize;
[cf. घिण्ण् and घुण्ण्.]

घृण, अस्, m. heat, ardour, sunshine; (आ), f. a
warm feeling towards others, compassion, tenderness,
pity; reproach, blame, censure, aversion, contempt;
[cf. निर्-घृण and हृणीया.]
—घृणार्चिस् (˚ण-
अर्˚), इस्, m. fire.
घृणालु, उस्, उस्, उ, compassionate, pitiful.

घृणि, इस्, m. heat, ardour, sunshine; a ray of
the sun or moon, the sun; a wave, water; (इस्, इस्, इ),
displeasing, disagreeable.
—घृणी-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
Ved. burning, shining; (आन्), m. a kind of animal.
घृणित, अस्, आ, अम्, pitied; reproached, abused, hated.

घृणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, merciful, tender-hearted, com-
passionate; censorious, abusive.
—घृणि-त्व, अम्,
n. mercifulness, compassion, pity.

घृणावास घृणावास, अस्, m. (probably for
घन-वास), a kind of pumpkin-gourd; [cf. कुष्-
माण्ड.]
